what_happened: Per project history, on 10-12 truncated Doubao, Grok and DeepSeek bodies had been accepted as deliveries and were later rejected; on 10-14 two entries of 识神.md held a tool-truncation placeholder or were missing.
expected: A delivery is accepted only with finish_reason=stop and a completion marker, and a core memory file is never overwritten by a model's partial output.

root_cause.text: Acceptance looked at the presence of text, not at end-of-output evidence.

rule: Reject any output without finish_reason=stop and the completion marker, and never write model output into a core memory file without the integrity check.
